subtitle: Don Alfonso: aria from Così fan tutte, Act 1 (No. 5)

passages.label: Vorrei dir, e cor non ho
Ho di voi, di lor pietà (to the end)

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 3, No. 5 Aria
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (quà). The aria opens with fato!, the end of Don Alfonso's line Barbaro fato! from the recitative before, as the print sets it.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 33–34, bars 1–38 of No. 5
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. Bar 1 holds fato!, the last word of the recitative before (attacca subito). Playback tempo: a half note = 123 (♩ = 246), from Böhm's recording (0:40, which includes the 3-bar Barbaro fato); Mozart gives the words Allegro agitato only.
